# Plan: Removing legacy skills and agents

**Generated by:** li-plan, 2026-09-25
**Status:** APPROVED within the reconciled execution contract and ownership update.
**Specification:** [spec.md](spec.md)

## Summary

Implement six disjoint lanes against the actual incoming capabilities, then reconcile
upstream main and the complete command/reference surface. Historical task IDs below
retain traceability, with current acceptance replacing stale deletion proposals.
This is the single task authority; coordination contains no second backlog.

## Plan signals

Size XL. Six implementation packages and one coordinator package. Phases: BUILD,
REVIEW, SHIP, CAPTURE. Whole-cycle token estimate remains uncalibrated; no measured
capacity or spend is claimed. No additional resource ceiling was requested.

## Profile impact

Use the repository-local verified profile context and existing neutral fallback
only when its resolver validates it. No enterprise control is inferred from installed
files. Frozen requirements/evidence/profile contracts remain authoritative.

## Verification procedures

W1: planning/DEFINE/inspect regression checks and `workflow-root-and-trio`.
W2: diagnosis, verification-mode negatives, agent/reference structural checks.
W3: context checkpoint roundtrip, ownership, safe selection, memory and frozen-zone checks.
W4: browser/design pipeline and retained document consumer checks, with real versus fixture
evidence labelled; no unavailable PDF reader result.
W5: alias fixtures, native install update/conflict/pruning, transparent guard fixtures.
W6: current-tree and retained-history reference scan, touched-link and required-notice review.
Integration: selected work/topology/scope validators, generator checks, relevant shape/unit/
integration checks, then the unweakened strict hosted matrix and normal PR checks.
Exact commands and outputs belong in lane reports and final review, not guessed PASS fields.

## Reconciliation of historical advice

No new approval interview, removal quota, encoded-token guard, new installer inventory,
PDF/workbook/provider deletion, mandatory checkpoint-key migration, old-save expiry,
remote branch/history cleanup or old PR edit is selected. Corresponding historical
substeps are superseded by this explicit current contract, not silently counted complete.
Repeated historical per-lane generation/full-suite substeps become coordinator 10.1.a/10.5.a.
Instruction parity and optional broader removals remain unchanged unless complete coverage
and actual necessity are established.

## Review

Pending actual independent specification/capability review, then quality/verification.
The map's approval is scope authority, not a review result or release clearance.
